module origen_147221(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    input sub,
    output out
);

    wire [31:0] mult_result;
    wire [31:0] adder_result;
    wire [31:0] xor_result;

    multiplier mult_inst (
        .a(a),
        .b(b),
        .result(mult_result)
    );

    adder adder_inst (
        .a(a),
        .b(b),
        .sub(sub),
        .result(adder_result)
    );

    bitwise_xor xor_inst (
        .a(mult_result),
        .b({adder_result, 16'b0}),
        .result(xor_result)
    );

    assign out = ^xor_result;

endmodule

module multiplier(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    output [31:0] result
);

    reg [31:0] product;
    reg [15:0] multiplier;
    integer i;

    always @(*) begin
        product = 32'b0;
        multiplier = b;
        
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
            if (multiplier[0])
                product = product + (a << i);
            multiplier = multiplier >> 1;
        end
    end

    assign result = product;

endmodule

module adder(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    input sub,
    output [31:0] result
);

    wire [15:0] b_xor;
    wire [15:0] sum_low, sum_high;
    wire carry;

    assign b_xor = b ^ {16{sub}};

    adder_16bit adder_low (
        .a(a),
        .b(b_xor),
        .cin(sub),
        .sum(sum_low),
        .cout(carry)
    );

    adder_16bit adder_high (
        .a(16'b0),
        .b(16'b0),
        .cin(carry),
        .sum(sum_high),
        .cout()
    );

    assign result = {sum_high, sum_low};

endmodule

module adder_16bit(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    input cin,
    output [15:0] sum,
    output cout
);

    assign {cout, sum} = a + b + cin;

endmodule

module bitwise_xor(
    input [31:0] a,
    input [31:0] b,
    output [31:0] result
);

    assign result = a ^ b;

endmodule
